glossary.definition: (1) "Scrap metal dealer" means the owner or operator of a business that purchases or receives scrap metal for the purpose of sorting, grading, and shipping metals to third parties for direct or indirect melting into new products.

glossary.source_title: Section 4737.04 - Scrap metal and merchandise container dealers; exertion of control over certain articles; record keeping.

glossary.definition: (3) "Bulk merchandise container" has the same meaning as in section 4737.012 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in this section and sections 4737.041 , 4737.042 , 4737.043 , 4737.044 , 4737.045 , and 4737.99 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (4) "Bulk merchandise container dealer" means a dealer who is subject to section 4737.012 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in this section and sections 4737.041 , 4737.042 , 4737.043 , 4737.044 , 4737.045 , and 4737.99 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4737.04 - Scrap metal and merchandise container dealers; exertion of control over certain articles; record keeping.

glossary.definition: (5) "Common recycled matter" means bottles and other containers made out of steel, tin, or aluminum and other consumer goods that are metal that are recycled by individual consumers and not in the bulk or quantity that could be supplied or recycled by large business establishments. "Common recycled matter" does not include a metal tray used by a product producer, distributor, retailer, or agent of a product producer, distributor, or retailer as a means for the bulk transportation, storage, or carrying of retail containers of milk, baked goods, eggs, or bottled beverage products.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in this section and sections 4737.041 , 4737.042 , 4737.043 , 4737.044 , 4737.045 , and 4737.99 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4737.04 - Scrap metal and merchandise container dealers; exertion of control over certain articles; record keeping.

glossary.definition: (6) "Consumer goods" has the same meaning as in section 1309.102 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in this section and sections 4737.041 , 4737.042 , 4737.043 , 4737.044 , 4737.045 , and 4737.99 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4737.04 - Scrap metal and merchandise container dealers; exertion of control over certain articles; record keeping.

glossary.definition: (7) "Recyclable materials" means the metal materials described in division (C)(5) of this section, on the condition that those metal materials are not special purchase articles.
